'''Yoko Asada''' (Japanese: '''浅田葉子''' ''Asada Yoko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Asada was born on May 23, 1969, in {{wp|Hyōgo Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|OS}} and voiced {{ka|Lily}}, one of {{an|Misty}}'s [[Sensational Sisters|older sisters]]. Asada is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}}.
